main_text.p: [illegible, ~10 letters]inaretur: nec minùs distentam ob-ervavimus canis vesiculam fellis. in-[?]nsus etiam & velut urens calor in-erceptum illud duodeni spacium oc-[?]upabat, cui cùm lanceolâ vulnuscu-[?]um infligerem, cum humore quodam [?]o contento flatus cum strepitu & [?]repitu atque vapores & exhalationes [?]roruperunt, unde acris quidam fœtor [?]ares omnium feriebat, quem magis [?]perto intestino cominùs exceptum [?]tudiosorum nemo ferre poterat, ma-[?]ifesto argumento non modò eò pro-[?]uxisse tantam copiam bilis atque suc-[?]i pancreatici: sed etiam in iis effers-[?]escentiam fuisse excitatam, non me-[?]iocrem tantum aut blandam, qualis [?]anis contingit, sed vehementem: non [?]nim intestini illa pars duntaxat plena [?]rat, sed etiam vi quadam & orgasmo [?]ummè distenta. Nec eam duodeni [?]artem ita potuisse distendi, nec tanta [?]i dissipari humores, flatus, vapores [?]c exhalationes, nisi vi effervescentiæ sive

page.notes: Left edge is cut off, so many initial letters are lost or only partly visible; the bracketed fragments mark where letters are missing. The marks "[?]" are placed on words where the reading is uncertain. The first line is partly cut off, and the opening word is not clear enough to read.
